title: GPT-6 Astra resolves the spectral isometry conjecture for arbitrary unital C*-algebras
summary: The paper proves that every unital surjective complex-linear spectral isometry between unital C*-algebras is a Jordan isomorphism; without unitality, such a map is a central-unitary multiple of a Jordan isomorphism. The proof establishes that entire one-parameter groups of unital spectral isometries are algebra automorphisms, then reduces the general case to the commutative case. The authors report that the result was formally verified in Lean.
organization: University of Cambridge; California Institute of Technology
